title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Recruitment Specialist
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–8 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Recruitment Specialist to join our talent acquisition team in Kochi. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates using Naukri and other recruitment platforms\-Linkedin ,Pyjama and other Job portals . You will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment for multiple positions across various industries. Recruitment Specialists typically handle candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and maintaining recruitment databases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, and job portals.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Post job openings and manage job advertisements.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for ongoing requirements.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience from sourcing to onboarding.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 2–6 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri Resdex and Nvite candidate sourcing.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Familiarity with MS Excel and recruitment tools/ATS.


**Preferred Skills**
* Boolean search expertise.
* Candidate relationship management.
* Excellent negotiation and coordination skills.
* Target\-driven and self\-motivated approach.


**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Edappally ,Kochi, Kerala

title: Senior Manager – Recruitment
description:
📍 Location: Infopark Phase 2 ,Kochi,Kerala
 



 💼 Experience: 6\-8 years
 



 🏢 Work Model: Work From Office/General Shift
 



  





 The Senior Manager – Recruitment will lead and manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition function, ensuring achievement of hiring targets within defined timelines, budget guidelines, and quality standards. The role involves driving sourcing strategies, managing recruitment teams, overseeing stakeholder and vendor management, optimizing recruitment processes, and ensuring a strong candidate experience while aligning hiring delivery with business objectives.
 



  





**Duties and responsibilities:** 




  





**Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, workforce plans, and hiring priorities.
* Develop recruitment strategies for volume, niche, and leadership hiring requirements.
* Create sourcing plans aligned to business expansion, attrition trends, and critical skill requirements.
* Drive recruitment process improvements to enhance efficiency, candidate quality, and hiring outcomes.



**Team Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters and sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requisitions based on recruiter capability, bandwidth, and business priority.
* Monitor team productivity, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment pipeline health.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability\-building initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SLAs, policies, and compliance standards



**Talent Sourcing \& Networking** 



* Oversee sourcing activities across multiple channels including job portals, employee referrals, social media platforms, consultants, and internal databases.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Develop market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, and competitor hiring practices.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to improve talent attraction.



**Screening \& Selection** 



* Guide recruiters in candidate assessment and shortlisting processes to ensure hiring quality.
* Ensure structured screening and interview processes are followed across all business units.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to ensure timely interview feedback and decision\-making.
* Monitor selection quality and ensure alignment with competency and cultural fit requirements.



**Stakeholder \& Candidate Management** 



* Build strong working relationships with business leaders and hiring stakeholders.
* Ensure seamless and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Handle escalations related to recruitment delivery, offer negotiations, and candidate engagement.



**Recruitment Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure accurate maintenance of recruitment data, reports, and ATS records.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, dashboards, and periodic hiring reports.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
* Support HR audits and management reviews related to talent acquisition processes.



**Recruitment Budget Planning** 



* Prepare and manage the annual recruitment budget in alignment with workforce planning and business hiring projections.
* Monitor recruitment\-related expenses including job portals, consultancy fees, campus hiring, employee referral payouts, travel expenses etc.
* Track budget utilization against approved allocations and ensure cost\-effective hiring practices.
* Coordinate with Finance and Business Heads for recruitment forecasting and manpower budgeting exercises.



**External Vendor Management** 



* Manage external recruitment vendors, job portals, and hiring partners to support recruitment activities
* Coordinate and monitor recruitment processes related to consultants, agencies, and sourcing platforms to ensure effective hiring support.
* Oversee the usage and performance of job portals and external hiring channels to improve sourcing efficiency and recruitment outcomes.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with labour laws and internal HR policies.
* Support employer branding initiatives by promoting company culture and values through job postings and social media platforms.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




  




* MBA in HR stream or Graduation in any discipline
* 10\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing a recruitment team.
* Experience handling volume hiring, niche hiring, and stakeholder management.
* Exposure to ATS platforms, job portals, market standards and recruitment analytics preferred.

title: TC - CS - Senior - DPP - FY 27 Proactive Hiring - Data Privacy
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Cyber Security (DPP) – Technology Consulting –** 
**Senior**
 As part of our EY Cyber security, Technology Consulting team, your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You will be responsible for delivery and maintaining quality of services and deliverables on your engagements. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY and GDS within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Senior Consultant who help our clients improve their security and data protection posture to respond to the dynamic data and security threats. You will provide data privacy and protection domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build, deploy and test pragmatic security solutions that will give real and tangible benefits and security enhancement. In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture and help fellow team members to develop and grow together.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the execution of comprehensive Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for clients, identifying potential data privacy risks and providing their remediation plans.
* Develop and implement robust consent management frameworks to ensure clients' adherence to data subject consent requirements as per applicable regulations.
* Conduct in\-depth data privacy gap assessments and maturity assessments to identify areas for improvement and guide clients in developing a strategic roadmap for program enhancement.
* Provide strategic guidance on data subject rights, including access requests, rectification requests, and erasure requests.
* Craft and implement effective incident response plans to manage data breaches and privacy incidents, minimizing risk and upholding regulatory compliance.
* Develop and maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPAs) for clients, ensuring transparency and accountability.
* Partner with clients to develop and maintain comprehensive privacy policies and procedures that align with industry best practices and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Cultivate a deep understanding of the latest data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, DPDPA, China PIPL, etc) and advise clients on their potential business implications.
* Facilitate training sessions for both internal and client teams to raise awareness of data privacy best practices.
* Effectively manage stakeholder relationships, ensuring clear communication and project alignment.
* Foster strong collaboration with colleagues across diverse disciplines (e.g., legal, technology) to deliver holistic privacy solutions to clients.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Relevant work Experience: 4 to 6 years.
* Proven track record of successfully conducting PIAs, DPIAs, privacy gap assessments, and privacy maturity assessments for diverse clients.
* In\-depth knowledge of data subject rights and experience in supporting clients with their fulfilment.
* A proven ability to develop and implement data breach response plans and manage privacy incidents effectively.
* Experience in developing privacy strategies and roadmaps.
* Experience in planning and implementation of privacy controls.
* Strong understanding on RoPA documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to craft and maintain comprehensive privacy policies and procedures.
* Proficiency in a variety of data privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, DPDPA etc.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify complex privacy issues and develop practical solutions.
* A passion for data privacy and a commitment to staying current with evolving industry trends and regulations.
* Good Understanding of risk assessment frameworks.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduates / BE \- B. Tech / MCA / M. Sc (Stats, Maths, Computer Science) / MBA with background in computer science and programming.
* Certifications related to Data Privacy such as CIPP, CIPM, CIPT etc.
* Functional and non\-functional privacy requirements definition and documentation experience.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and Lead Implementer.


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Hr Recruiter
description:
**Company Description** 
 Giridhar Eye Institute (GEI), located in Kadavanthara, Kochi, is an NABH\-accredited eye hospital offering a broad range of comprehensive eye care services. Established in 1997, GEI has grown into a recognized center of excellence known for its strong commitment to values and ethical medical practice. The institute focuses on delivering personalized, high\-quality care at an affordable cost to patients from diverse backgrounds. Team members at GEI work in a professional, patient\-centric environment that emphasizes integrity, clinical excellence, and continuous improvement. Joining GEI means contributing to a mission\-driven organization dedicated to patient satisfaction and community eye health.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site HR Recruiter role based in Kochi. The HR Recruiter will manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including understanding staffing needs, drafting job descriptions, sourcing candidates, screening resumes, and scheduling and coordinating interviews. The role involves maintaining candidate pipelines, managing communication with applicants, and supporting hiring managers in selection and offer processes. The HR Recruiter will also assist with onboarding new employees, maintaining recruitment records, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and relevant labor regulations. In addition, the role may support employer branding initiatives, campus drives, and HR projects aimed at improving talent acquisition and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in candidate sourcing, resume screening, and interview coordination.
* Ability to manage recruitment cycles, from job posting and shortlisting to offer and onboarding.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, basic labor laws, and ethical hiring standards.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HR databases, and MS Office tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively at all levels.
* Strong organizational, time management, and follow\-up skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in recruitment, preferably in healthcare or hospital settings, is highly desirable.
* Commitment to confidentiality, fairness, and non\-discriminatory hiring practices.

title: People Operations Admin @ Resonate CX
description:
**People Operations Admin** 





 Recruitment  •  People Operations  •  Administration  •  Global Team Support
 




**About Resonate** 





 Resonate is an Australian customer experience (CX) software company. For a decade, we’ve helped organisations listen to their customers and act on what they hear. Today, we work across global markets, supported by a team spanning Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
 





 We’re at an exciting point in our journey — growing, investing in our product, and building the kind of company people are proud to be part of. This is a brand\-new role, created to help us do exactly that.
 




**The Role** 





 As our People Operations Admin, you’ll play an important role in keeping our People Operations running smoothly and helping create a great employee experience across Resonate.
 





 This is a hands\-on role covering recruitment, people administration, onboarding, employee experience, culture initiatives and day\-to\-day People \& Culture support. You’ll work closely with the People \& Culture team, managers and employees across our global locations.
 




**What You’ll Do** 




**Recruitment** 



* Support recruitment activities including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.



**People Operations \& Administration** 



* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day People \& Culture administration, reporting and employee lifecycle processes.
* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, including introductions, systems access and resources.



**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support employee engagement, recognition, surveys, culture initiatives and internal People \& Culture communications.
* Help coordinate company events, team activities and employee programs.



**Global Team Support** 



* Support employees across Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
* Coordinate activities across locations and time zones and work with local providers and partners.
* Help create connection, consistency and a positive employee experience across our distributed teams.



  





**About You** 





 You’re organised, approachable and genuinely enjoy helping people. You don’t need to know everything about HR — what matters most is that you’re curious, proactive and eager to learn.
 



* 1–3 years’ experience in HR, People \& Culture, People Operations, administration, recruitment or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive approach, good problem\-solving skills and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office/365\.
* Ability to work confidently with AI tools and an interest in smarter ways of working.
* Basic graphic design skills.
* Event planning or coordination experience is a nice\-to\-have.
* Experience working with distributed or global teams is an advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Broad exposure to People \& Culture and the opportunity to build your HR career.
* Real ownership and the opportunity to make an impact from day one.
* Exposure to leaders and teams across a growing global business.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The opportunity to grow with Resonate as the business continues to evolve.
* Opportunities to travel and experience different parts of the world.



**Why Resonate?** 





 At Resonate, we believe great customer experiences start with great employee experiences. We’re a growing, global team that values collaboration, curiosity, ownership and having a bit of fun along the way.
 





 If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, contribute and make a real difference to the employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.
 




**How to Apply** 





 If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and tell us a little about yourself and why you’d be a great addition to the Resonate team.
